scope: Component cost census by synthetic flopscope billing at production shapes, an eigenvalue-clip census on the frozen eight-row roster, and one target-free conditional-repair A/B probe; no targets read, no deployment change.

conditional_repair_probe.mechanism: Attempt Cholesky of the symmetrized correlation minus the PSD floor times identity; on success the eigh round trip is a numerical identity and is skipped (rescale and return); on failure the exact original path runs unchanged; the floor arm is untouched.

attribution_verdict.repair_eigh: The standout low-value component: about 275e9 FLOPs per row buys a numerical identity on roughly 92% of calls; skipping it under a Cholesky certificate changes outputs by 1.9e-5 of the error scale.
attribution_verdict.cp3_exact_carrier: Dominant cost (~0.9e12) but protected by the exact-carry law; not a candidate.
attribution_verdict.stars_and_cp4: Mid-cost and mechanism-load-bearing (the quartic star is the localization's birth marker); not candidates.
attribution_verdict.adjusted_score_implication: At the banked raw 2.9409640056599073e-8, freeing 274.89e9 lowers F/2^41 from 0.9694 to about 0.8444 and the per-row adjusted score to about 2.483e-8, a 12.8% board improvement with raw unchanged at the 1.9e-5 relative level - contingent on full-688 validation, an exact literal meter, and fresh user submission authority.
attribution_verdict.lambda3_funding_implication: The freed budget exceeds the full lambda-cubed shell cost (156.5e9) with about 118e9 margin, so the U cost closure is conditionally reopened only through this reallocation; the shell's effect size remains unmeasured and is a separate question.
attribution_verdict.dq_policy_note: This is algorithmic redundancy elimination inside our own estimator (a certified identity is skipped), not op-pricing arbitrage or a cheaper-forward billing exploit; it is defensible as method under the recorded DQ policy, and the distinction must be restated in any deployment preregistration.
